Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}

The Ventrue are the ruling clan of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}, drawn from leaders, executives, nobles, and commanders who see authority over Kindred and kine alike as both their right and their responsibility. They are selective in their Embraces, seeking only those with proven capacity for leadership.

Disciplines: Dominate, Fortitude, Presence

Advantage: All Ventrue begin with an extra Resources Background Trait that can never be permanently lost, plus one Trait of Finance, High Society or Political Influence.

Disadvantage: Ventrue can feed only from mortal blood meeting a particular dietary restriction; any other mortal blood is reflexively regurgitated with no nourishment. This does not apply to vampiric vitae.

Organization: Forms the backbone of @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} princes and primogen across the world, with clan members expected to maintain decorum and uphold the sect's traditions.

See also: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{the Camarilla}, of which Ventrue is one of the founding clans.
